# SperaCode — Company and services summary

## Company overview
SperaCode (سبيرا كود) is a software house based in Egypt. It designs, develops, launches, and supports digital products for businesses. The team works remotely and publishes information in Arabic and English.

- Official website: https://lumina-seven-pearl-99.vercel.app/
- Arabic homepage: https://lumina-seven-pearl-99.vercel.app/
- English homepage: https://lumina-seven-pearl-99.vercel.app/en
- Arabic portfolio: https://lumina-seven-pearl-99.vercel.app/projects
- English portfolio: https://lumina-seven-pearl-99.vercel.app/en/projects
- Contact: https://lumina-seven-pearl-99.vercel.app/contact
- English contact: https://lumina-seven-pearl-99.vercel.app/en/contact

## Public company facts
- Name: SperaCode
- Arabic name: سبيرا كود
- Location: Egypt; client work can be delivered remotely
- Languages: Arabic and English
- Website statistics currently stated by SperaCode: 50+ projects delivered, 45 clients served, and 6+ years of experience
- Support: post-launch support and 24/7 technical support are described on the website

## Services
- Web development: corporate websites, e-commerce, and custom web applications.
- Mobile applications: iOS and Android applications focused on usable, reliable experiences.
- Digital QR menus: digital restaurant and café menus with Arabic and English content and WhatsApp ordering.
- AI solutions: chatbots, workflow automation, and AI integrations.
- UI/UX design: interfaces shaped around user needs and business goals.
- Maintenance and support: bug fixes, performance improvements, and security maintenance for existing products.
- Business email, domains, and hosting: digital setup under the client's brand.
- Custom software: dashboards, management systems, and internal tools tailored to workflows.

## Project approach
1. Discovery: understand business goals, users, and requirements.
2. Design: define the solution and plan its user experience.
3. Development: build the agreed product with modern technologies.
4. Testing and launch: test, deliver, and deploy the product.
5. Support and growth: maintain and improve the product after launch.

## Frequently asked questions
- Project timing: simple websites typically take 1–3 weeks; larger systems depend on scope. A timeline is provided after an initial consultation.
- Support: each project includes a support period, and monthly maintenance plans are available.
- Pricing: based on scope and features; a fixed written quote is provided before work starts.
- Remote work: meetings, delivery, and support can be handled online.
- Ownership: code and design ownership transfers to the client upon final payment.
- Existing products: SperaCode can audit, fix, optimize, or rebuild an existing website or app.

## Portfolio guidance
The portfolio page is the source for project descriptions and demo links. Some linked systems may require sign-in. Distinguish live websites, demos, and concept visuals based on the project page; do not infer client relationships or deployment status from screenshots alone.

## Contact and privacy
The contact form prepares a message for WhatsApp. Visitors review and send that message themselves; the website does not store those form details on its server.
